softwarePrdDescription: Turn a product brief into testable requirements, explicit scope and acceptance criteria.
softwarePrdExample: Draft a PRD for a document approval flow. Include permissions, rejection, resubmission and acceptance criteria.
technicalProposalDescription: Compare practical options and explain an implementation with clear failure and migration paths.
technicalProposalExample: Propose a search indexing service alongside SQLite, including consistency checks and rebuild recovery.
apiContractDescription: Define requests, responses, authentication and error behavior with consistent examples.
apiContractExample: Define an API for submitting and inspecting Bot tasks, with idempotent retries and conflict examples.
meetingNotesDescription: Separate decisions, action items and open questions from a meeting transcript.
meetingNotesExample: Turn this transcript into decisions and actions. Mark missing owners and deadlines explicitly.
decisionBriefDescription: Make a decision easy to assess through evidence, options and a clear recommendation.
decisionBriefExample: Compare building and buying a search service, then draft a one-page recommendation for a small team.
releaseNotesDescription: Explain shipped changes, upgrade steps and known limitations in user-facing language.
releaseNotesExample: Write customer release notes from these verified changes. Keep preview-only features separate from shipped behavior.
longformEditorDescription: Improve an article's argument and flow while preserving its facts and the author's voice.
longformEditorExample: Restructure this article for engineering leads. Keep the author's voice and identify unsupported claims.
researchDigestDescription: Synthesize supplied sources into findings, evidence gaps and practical implications.
researchDigestExample: Summarize these studies on onboarding. Compare their evidence and identify what a product team can reasonably conclude.
conceptExplainerDescription: Explain a difficult concept through a precise definition, an example and its limits.
conceptExplainerExample: Explain idempotency to a junior developer, using a payment retry example and a counterexample.
evidenceComparisonDescription: Compare options against the same criteria without inventing precision or hiding missing evidence.
evidenceComparisonExample: Compare these three document editors for an offline team using only the provided specifications.
executiveDeckDescription: Plan a focused presentation with slide takeaways, evidence and speaker notes.
executiveDeckExample: Plan a ten-minute roadmap review for executives, including tradeoffs and the decision needed.
lessonDeckDescription: Design a teachable slide sequence with examples, practice and checks for understanding.
lessonDeckExample: Design a thirty-minute lesson on database indexes for developers, with a worked example and two exercises.
scienceIllustrationDescription: Turn a concept into an accurate illustration brief and a usable image prompt.
scienceIllustrationExample: Plan a child-friendly illustration of the water cycle, with accurate arrows, labels and alt text.
infographicBriefDescription: Organize a process or dataset into an honest, readable infographic plan.
infographicBriefExample: Plan an infographic of this onboarding funnel, preserving denominators and explaining where users drop off.
landingPageBriefDescription: Plan a page around audience needs, credible proof and one clear primary action.
landingPageBriefExample: Plan a landing page for a local document workspace. Use only the supplied product facts.
informationArchitectureDescription: Turn a confusing content set into clear navigation, labels and findable user journeys.
informationArchitectureExample: Reorganize these skill categories and personal shortcuts without adding duplicate global navigation.
shortFilmStoryboardDescription: Translate a story into timed shots, visual continuity and clear production notes.
shortFilmStoryboardExample: Write a sixty-second storyboard explaining how a small team turns notes into a shared knowledge base.
productDemoScriptDescription: Show a real user task with accurate product behavior, concise narration and useful pacing.
productDemoScriptExample: Script a ninety-second demo of importing, finding and pinning a skill, with synthetic example data.
packageDescription: Structured guides for writing, research, and creative planning.
deliverable: Deliverable: an editable document. Creative skills provide plans, outlines, or prompts; rendering is a separate capability.
